Marseille lift the cup on Ferrand's late free kick

By A. Reporter

The keeper stayed rooted to his line. Ferrand curled the free kick around a four-man wall in the 88th minute, and Marseille took the cup for the first time in twenty years.

It was a night that turned on one decision. Duval had waved play on twice before, and the wall never reset. Marseille pressed the advantage while the defence argued with the referee.

Afterwards the coach was blunt about it. He said the wall had been drilled all week to step across on the whistle, and that the goal was a coaching failure rather than a goalkeeping one.

Marseille finished the season with 74 points, two clear of Bordeaux, and will defend the trophy in September against a side that has not beaten them since 1988.
